adapter.serving: native, no merge; all evaluation conditions enable LoRA engine

checkpoint_selection: fixed final checkpoint, no selection or tuning on held-out results

evaluation.shift: levels 3,6,12,24 AND renamed terminals/nonterminals; same six families; combined shift, not unseen families
evaluation.thinking_prompt: unchanged; parser separates reasoning from final answer

examples: 1024 rows: unchanged action row plus either duplicated action row or separate auxiliary task; equal rows, not equal action-target exposure or compute
limitations: Single seed and small fixed training budget; no optimal-method ranking
Auxiliary arms trade half of standalone action practice for richer targets
Different target lengths and teacher passes imply unequal compute
Historical set already observed; new shifted set frozen before model evaluation
Frozen non-thinking evidence teacher and forward KL are an adaptation, not an exact SPSD replication
No learned expert search, MCTS, environment rollout optimization, or test-time evidence supplied
External state loop stops at first error; no robustness-to-tool-failure experiment
name: A7 evidence/objective matched pilot

opsd.loss: full vocabulary forward KL(teacher || student) on student sampled tokens, equal weight per row
opsd.teacher: frozen original base conditioned on verified reference target

smoke: 2 updates on training-only states for both objectives; longest auxiliary target included; discarded checkpoint
training: 512 states: 8 per each of 64 original train trajectories; operation coverage then deterministic hash fill
